status_incompatible: Tablet Helper is not active: this POEFixer version is not compatible with the plugin.
status_help:
Open your inventory, a stash tab (the Tablet stash too), the guild stash or a merchant: matching tablets are outlined in their type's colour.

Each tablet type has its own rule below. A rule without bonuses highlights every tablet of that type; pick bonuses to highlight only tablets that carry them. "All types" is an extra rule that applies to every type.

Filter profiles keep several sets of rules you can switch between.
status_hint: Highlights Precursor Tablets in every open item window, coloured by type and filtered by their bonuses and uses left.
status_reading_tip: Tablets whose modifiers are still being read. Tablets matched by bonuses or uses left appear as soon as their read completes (a full Tablet stash takes about a second).
highlight_style_tip:
How a matching tablet is marked:
Border - a frame around the tablet's cell.
Cross - two diagonal lines over the tablet.
Star - a small star in the cell's lower-left corner.
highlight_thickness_tip: Width of the frame, cross or star lines in pixels.
labels_type_name_tip: Writes the tablet's type (Breach, Ritual, ...) in the top of its cell. A name too long for the cell is drawn smaller, then shortened to three letters (Exp, Ovs, ...).
labels_matched_bonuses_tip:
Lists the selected bonuses the tablet carries under its type name, required ones first. Names that do not fit the cell are shortened and "+N" counts the ones left out.
A cell too small for names (most stash cells) shows {check} instead: how many of the selected bonuses the tablet carries.
labels_uses_left_tip:
Shows the tablet's remaining uses as {badge} in the cell's lower-right corner.
Needs "Read tablet modifiers" (Detection).
labels_text_colour_tip:
Colour of the type name: white, or the colour of the tablet's rule.
Bonus names and the uses badge are always white.
labels_text_size_tip: Label size relative to the overlay font. Labels never leave their tablet's cell: text that does not fit is drawn smaller or shortened.
labels_background_tip: Opacity of the dark box behind each label line.
labels_dark_box_tip: Draws a dark rounded box behind each label line so it reads on bright item art.
labels_outline_tip: Draws a thin black outline around label text.
detection_read_mods_tip:
Reads each tablet's modifiers once, when it first appears on screen. Needed for the uses-left filter and badge and for every bonus filter.

Off: every enabled type is highlighted by type only and the filters are ignored.
detection_paused: Bonus and uses-left filters are paused while this is off.
detection_refresh_tip:
How often the open item windows are checked for tablets. Lower follows tab switches and moved items sooner; higher asks the game for less.
With no item window open the plugin checks at most every 300 ms. Default 150 ms.
profiles_help: A profile is a complete set of tablet rules: colours, bonuses and uses left for every type. Keep one per strategy and switch here. Highlight, label and detection options are shared by all profiles.
profiles_active_tip: The rules in use. Switching re-filters the open windows at once.
profiles_new_tip: Adds a profile with the default rules (every tablet by type) and switches to it.
profiles_duplicate_tip: Copies the active profile and switches to the copy.
profiles_delete_tip: Deletes the active profile (asks first). The last profile cannot be deleted.
profiles_delete_confirm: Delete this profile and its rules?
types_help:
Tick a type to highlight it and pick its colour. "Edit" opens the type's filter: bonuses, roll values and uses left.

"All types" is an extra rule tested on every tablet. A tablet its own type's rule does not highlight is still highlighted, in the "All types" colour, when that rule accepts it.
types_colour_tip: Highlight colour of this type (the alpha slider sets its opacity).
types_edit_tip: Open this type's filter: bonuses, roll values, uses left.
editor_paused: "Read tablet modifiers" is off: this filter is paused and every enabled tablet of the type is highlighted.
editor_min_uses_tip: Only highlight tablets with at least this many uses left. "Any" = no limit.
editor_required_tip: How many of the bonuses marked "Required" a tablet must carry. Set it to the number of required bonuses to demand all of them.
editor_optional_tip: How many of the other selected bonuses a tablet must carry.
editor_no_bonus: No bonus selected: every tablet of this type is highlighted.
bonuses_search_tip: Type part of a bonus name or mod id, e.g. "rarity", "surpassing" or "waystone".
bonuses_selected_only_tip: Show only the bonuses ticked for this type.
bonuses_clear_tip: Unticks every bonus of this type and clears their value limits.
bonuses_col_bonus_tip: Tick the bonuses to look for. Hover a name for its mod id.
bonuses_col_required_tip: A required bonus counts in the "Required bonuses" pool instead of the optional one.
bonuses_col_min_tip: Lowest roll to accept for a ticked bonus. Empty = no limit.
bonuses_col_max_tip: Highest roll to accept for a ticked bonus. Empty = no limit.
bonuses_required_tip:
Required: counted in the "Required bonuses" pool instead of the optional one.
Use it for must-have bonuses, e.g. one required plus any two of five others.
bonuses_min_tip:
Lowest value to accept. Known rolls: {min} to {max}.
Empty = no limit.
bonuses_max_tip:
Highest value to accept. Known rolls: {min} to {max}.
Empty = no limit.
bonuses_fixed_tip: This bonus has a single fixed value: there is nothing to limit.
diag_tip: Read timings, modifier reads, remembered tablets, roll ranges and a modifier dump.
diag_ranges_overridden: Built-in mod ranges: {count}, overridden by tablet_mod_ranges.json: {overridden}
diag_dump_hint: The modifier dump writes the raw modifiers (mod ids, stat keys, values) of every tablet the game currently lists to config/tablet_debug_dump.txt, appending to the file. Use it to check the bonus list and roll ranges after a game patch.
diag_dump_write_tip: Up to 60 tablets per press. Open each stash tab with tablets and press once per tab.
